segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Item width: To lay out 3 items horizontally, use 1/3 of the width of the group. // Item height: To achieve a consistent height for the items, use `uniformAcrossSiblings(estimate:)`. let itemCount = 3 let itemSize = NSCollectionLayoutSize(widthDimension: .fractionalWidth(1.0 / CGFloat(itemCount)), heightDimension: .uniformAcrossSiblings(estimate: 50)) let item = NSCollectionLayoutItem(layoutSize: itemSize) // Group width: To use the entire horizontal width of the section, use the full fractional width. // Group height: To allow the group's height to grow for the items, use `estimated(_:)`. let groupSize = NSCollectionLayoutSize(widthDimension: .fractionalWidth(1.0), heightDimension: .estimated(50)) let group = NSCollectionLayoutGroup.horizontal(layoutSize: groupSize, repeatingSubitem: item, count: itemCount) let section = NSCollectionLayoutSection(group: group) ```
